front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《26》

en: Don't ask: what is the world of rivers and lakes?
The sword is sheathed, the lamp put out
A smile, holding up a flower

points.zh: 「 劍光揮斷恩仇結，掌風纏繞兒女情」。10/28/2018一代武俠小說宗師金庸，走完「俠之大者，快意人生」的戲鬧歲月。九十四年生涯留下《射雕英雄傳》、《笑傲江湖》、《神雕俠侶》、《天龍八部》、《倚天屠龍記》、《鹿鼎記》等十五部經典武俠作品，綜合結成「飛雪連天射白鹿，笑書神俠倚碧鴛」。龍其林教授評言 :“  金庸的武俠小說超越了時代、民族、地區、性别的限制，成為華人世界一個獨特的文學存在。他是偉大的傳統文化的堅守者，以深厚的學術修養、豊富的想象與深邃的思考，為我們勾勒了一個神奇的武俠世界。 ”
points.en: "The gleam of the sword severs the ties of enmity and gratitude; the force of the palm entwines the feelings between men and women." On October 28, 2018, Jin Yong (Louis Cha), the great master of martial arts fiction, completed his years of "great chivalry, joyful life." Over a span of 94 years, he left behind fifteen classic martial arts works, including "The Legend of the Condor Heroes," "The Smiling, Proud Wanderer," "The Return of the Condor Heroes," "Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils," "The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber," and "The Deer and the Cauldron," together summarized in the couplet "Flying snow fills the sky, shooting the white deer; laughing, he writes of gods and knights, leaning against the jade mandarin duck" (a mnemonic formed from the first character of each novel's title). Professor Long Qilin commented: "Jin Yong's martial arts novels transcend the boundaries of era, ethnicity, region, and gender, becoming a unique literary presence in the Chinese-speaking world. He was a great guardian of traditional culture who, with profound scholarship, rich imagination, and deep reflection, sketched out for us a wondrous world of martial arts."

en: Dusk, sitting in silent stillness, imagining
After the snow falls, what then, what then
A red leaf drifts down before the window

points.zh: Amber  ( 琥珀 )  is fossilized tree resin, which has been appreciated for its color and natural beauty and valued as gemstone. Some amber may contain insect or bubble which has been entrapped or sleeping inside since Neolithic times.

en: Counting the small certain joys along the riverbank

points.zh: 「小確幸」 一詞源自村上春樹的隨筆集《蘭格漢斯島的午后》。二十五篇散文寫的都是生活瑣事，跟村上的小說不同，他的散文樸實不虛幻，不帶傷感寂寞，經由敏銳獨特的視角，平常無奇的人事都顯得輕鬆嶲永，幽默可親。其中一篇是「小確幸」，就是說日常生活中“ 微小但確切的幸福和滿足 ”。「小確幸」一詞，經由翻譯家林少華直譯後，成為風行漢語世界的口語文詞。在日常生活中，都流淌著某些稍縱卽逝的幸福與美好，或是内心的滿足和寬懷，或是對生命的珍惜和感恩，當我們把這些「小確幸」逐一拾起時，就是人生最單純的快樂時光。
points.en: The term "xiao que xing" (a small but certain happiness) originates from Haruki Murakami's essay collection "Afternoon in the Islands of Langerhans." Its twenty-five essays all describe everyday trivialities; unlike his novels, his essays are plain and unadorned, free of melancholy or loneliness, and through a keen, distinctive perspective, ordinary people and events appear light, meaningful, humorous, and endearing. One of the essays is titled "A Small Certain Happiness," referring to "a small but definite happiness and satisfaction" in daily life. Through translator Lin Shaohua's literal rendering, the term became a widely used colloquial expression across the Chinese-speaking world. In everyday life there flow certain fleeting moments of happiness and beauty -- whether inner contentment and ease of mind, or gratitude and appreciation for life. When we gather up these small certain happinesses one by one, they become life's simplest moments of joy.

en: The stone says nothing, listening to the rain

points.zh: 「花若解語還多事，石不能言最可人。」
points.en: "If flowers could understand speech, they would cause too much trouble; a stone that cannot speak is most endearing."

zh: 愛 : 是一棵開花的樹
en: Love: it is a blossoming tree

points.zh:
《 一棵開花的樹 》席慕蓉
如何讓你遇見我
在我最美麗的時刻　為這
我已在佛前　求了五百年
求他讓我們結一段塵緣
　
佛於是把我化作一棵樹
長在你必經的路旁
陽光下慎重地開滿了花
朵朵都是我前世的盼望
　
當你走近　請你細聽
那顫抖的葉是我等待的熱情
而當你終於無視地走過
在你身後落了一地的
朋友啊　那不是花瓣
是我凋零的心
席慕蓉 ( 1943年 ~  ) ，本名穆倫．席連勃，當代畫家、詩人、散文家。1963年台灣師範大學美術系畢業，1966年比利時布魯塞爾皇家藝術學院畢業，獲得比利時皇家金牌獎等獎項。著有詩集、散文集、畫冊和選本等五十餘種。早期的作品以語言流暢，風格秀雅，節奏抒情，營造出一種夢幻情調的優美意境。席慕容的作品多寫爱情、人生、鄉愁，辭句淡雅剔透，抒情靈動，飽含着對生命的摯愛真情，影響了台灣整整一代人的成長歷程，1984年《七里香》、《無怨的青春》等六本創作并列十大暢銷排行榜，而有「席慕蓉年」之譽。2014年，獲得台灣“ 年度詩獎 ”。近年來，隨著歲月的更替，她的詩風轉變為沈穩、冷凝，特別是以她的故鄉蒙古為題材的詩作，更出入於蒙古歷史和文化之間，詩境遼遠開闊，有塞外蒼茫、淳厚、高曠的美感。2011年的《以詩之名》詩集，收入多首草原氣習的蒙古史詩。2017年出版《當夏夜芳馥：席慕蓉畫作精選集》，用詩畫呈現自我。
points.en:
《A Blooming Tree》 by Xi Murong
How could I make you meet me
at my most beautiful moment — for this
I have prayed before the Buddha for five hundred years,
begging him to let us form a worldly bond.

So the Buddha turned me into a tree,
growing beside the road you must pass.
Under the sunlight it solemnly bloomed with flowers,
every blossom the hope of my past life.

As you draw near, please listen closely —
those trembling leaves are the passion of my waiting.
And when you finally pass by without a glance,
what falls to the ground behind you,
my friend, is not petals —
it is my withered heart.
Xi Murong (1943- ), whose original name is Mulun Xilianbo, is a contemporary painter, poet, and essayist. She graduated from the Fine Arts Department of Taiwan Provincial Normal University in 1963, and from the Royal Academy of Fine Arts in Brussels, Belgium in 1966, where she received the Belgian Royal Gold Medal and other awards. She has authored more than fifty collections of poetry, essays, art books, and anthologies. Her early works are noted for their fluent language, elegant style, and lyrical rhythm, creating a beautiful, dreamlike mood. Xi Murong's works mostly write of love, life, and homesickness, with elegant, clear phrasing and lively lyricism, brimming with sincere devotion to life; she influenced an entire generation growing up in Taiwan. In 1984, six of her works including 《Seven-Mile Fragrance》 and 《Youth Without Regret》 simultaneously ranked among the top ten bestsellers, earning that year the reputation of "the Year of Xi Murong." In 2014 she received Taiwan's "Annual Poetry Award." In recent years, as the years have passed, her poetic style has shifted to become more measured and cool, especially in the poems on the theme of her homeland, Mongolia, which move between Mongolian history and culture, with a poetic vision that is vast and expansive, carrying the beauty of the desolate, deep, and open grandeur of the frontier. Her 2011 poetry collection 《In the Name of Poetry》 includes many epic poems steeped in the spirit of the grasslands. In 2017 she published 《When the Summer Night Is Fragrant: Selected Paintings of Xi Murong》, presenting herself through poetry and painting.
